provenance.note_scope: Frozen shipped artifact classified as served. It cannot be regenerated on a clean checkout (no .pt committed). The corrected generator is pipeline/export_v6_real_assets.py.

embeddings.note: 64-d model embedding for 2741 rows plus 2200 sector-centroid+Gaussian-noise PLACEHOLDER rows added by the 2026-07-20 S&P 500 expansion; x/y/z are PCA-3 of emb. See assets/eval_sector_coherence.json placeholder_contamination.

skills.note: Per-company skills are np.random.rand(12)*60+20 noise, not measured percentiles, yet rendered as the on-page Skills Radar. This model has no skills head, so skill grades are unavailable. Retained in this frozen artifact but flagged; the corrected generator emits null.

archetype.note: Assigned by an i % len(ARCHETYPE_NAMES) modulo cycle in the builder of record, not the model's archetype head. The corrected generator uses the model archetype head.

removed_fabricated_fields.note: Hardcoded metric literals (val_recall 0.882, purity 0.6586, sector_acc 0.5535, cqs 0.6347) and a mislabeled test_recall (aliased the IC) with no computation behind them. Removed per data_provenance_SOP.md. Real IC retained as ic.

ic_prec20.note: From the training checkpoint at build time; irreproducible now (no .pt committed).
